_comment: Тема risk: StopDailyATR × DailyATRPeriod (54 узла); источник StopDailyATR, DailyATRPeriod. Стоп 0 не входит. Запуск: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker MTSS -strategy rsi_zone -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_zone/mtss/cal_risk.json -out ./reports/MTSS_zone/r20261005/risk -months 36 -train-months 12 -test-months 6 -min-trades 20 -metric profit_factor.
